newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.

text.p: Activity slowed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange last week, exchange officials said.
They said traded volume fell to 220,950 shares valued at 2,378,409 kwacha, down from 1,681,561 shares worth 41,378,991 kwacha the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 12 kwacha in a traded volume of 60,482 shares worth 752,784 kwacha.
Rothmans gained two kwacha to end the week at 32 kwacha in a traded volume of 2,597 shares worth 79,958 kwacha.
Farmers House gained one kwacha to end the week at 240 kwacha in a traded volume of 406 shares worth 97,440 kwacha.
Chilanga Cement remined steady at 55 kwacha in a traded volume of 1,244 shares worth 67,237 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades in the week.
